title: Better Spawners Top
description: This texture pack retextures the top of the spawner. Also, the pack adds a few splash texts I am experimenting with for a new texture pack.
body:
For those who care for details, this texture pack retextures the top of the spawner.

Also, the pack adds a few splash texts I am experimenting with for a new texture pack. ( may be removed to a different pack in the future)
